sentences.en: Traffic on this road has been disrupted due to flooding.
sentences.zh: 由于洪水泛滥，这条路上的交通已经被中断。

sentences.en: Flooding is becoming more frequent along the U.S. coastline.
sentences.zh: 美国沿海地区的洪水频率正在变得越来越频繁。

sentences.en: They are flooding their border with us with military presence.
sentences.zh: 他们正用军事力量大量涌入我们的边境地区。

senses.zh: 泛滥,化溢流,医血崩,产后出血v.淹没(flood的现在分词),充满,溢出
